props.gloss_en: Rav (first version): a bed one designated for coins may not be moved
the mishna: one may move a new lamp, but not an old one
Rav (second version): a bed designated for coins on which he placed coins may not be moved
...designated, but he placed no coins on it -- it may be moved
...not designated, with coins on it -- it may not be moved
...not designated, with no coins on it -- it may be moved
...and that is provided there were no coins on it at twilight
the mishna: a wagon's detachable undercarriage is not joined to it [for impurity, measure and tent]; and one may not drag it on Shabbat while there are coins on it
that mishna is R' Shimon's, who has no muktze
R' Shimon does not hold the muktze prohibition
and Rav holds like R' Yehuda [on muktze]
Rav: one may place a lamp atop a palm tree [for] Shabbat
Rav: and one may not place a lamp atop a palm tree [for] Yom Tov
Rav, asked about moving a Chanukah lamp out of the chabarei's sight on Shabbat: it is fine
an emergency is different [so the Chanukah ruling does not show Rav rejects muktze]
Rav, to Rav Kahana and Rav Ashi (who asked: is that the halakha?): R' Shimon is worthy to rely on in an emergency

schemas.gloss_en: a lamp, which is made for this [lighting], may be moved when it has not been lit; a bed, which is not made for this [coins], all the more so

supports.gloss_en: הכי נמי מסתברא: Rav distinguishes Shabbat from Yom Tov for the lamp on a palm -- אי אמרת בשלמא כרבי יהודה, היינו דשני; אלא אי אמרת כרבי שמעון, מה לי שבת ומה לי יום טוב?
דהא אמרו ליה רב כהנא ורב אשי לרב: הכי הלכתא? אמר להו: כדי הוא רבי שמעון לסמוך עליו בשעת הדחק

objections.gloss_en: מתיב רב נחמן בר יצחק: מטלטלין נר חדש אבל לא ישן! -- if a lamp, made for lighting, may be moved while unlit, a bed not made for coins all the more so (kv_ner_mita, 44b.1). Unanswered: the report of Rav is restated (אלא אי איתמר הכי איתמר)
אמר עולא, מתיב רבי אליעזר: the undercarriage may not be dragged while coins are on it -- so without coins it is permitted, although they were on it at twilight (44b.3)!

objections.gloss_en: ורב כרבי יהודה סבירא ליה? והא בעו מיניה דרב: moving a Chanukah lamp out of the chabarei's sight on Shabbat -- and he said שפיר דמי!
